posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: José Ramírez took off for third base and drew Caminero to cover the bag. Jo Adell smacked a two-run double where Caminero was previously standing. It's 7-3 Guardians.
posts.jp: ホセ・ラミレスが三塁へ走り、カミネロがベースカバーに入った。直後、カミネロが立っていた場所にジョー・アデルが二点適時二塁打を叩き込む。ガーディアンズが7-3に。

posts.text: Dodgers are in a tough spot, down two games and forced to rely on their #3 starter, a two-time Cy Young winner who had a 1.90 ERA this year.
posts.jp: 2連敗で追い込まれたドジャース。頼るのは今季防御率1.90、サイ・ヤング賞2度の第3先発だ。

posts.text: The Orioles opened two business-side jobs in the last 24 hours: digital marketing coordinator and audience development coordinator. The pay is $45k-47k per year. The club also opened a baseball analytics data science job yesterday. All here: www.teamworkonline.com/jobs-in-spor...
